win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 8 or more symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Before each spin, up to 5 multipliers can appear in random positions behind the grid, with at least 1 guaranteed in bonus games. If a winning combination lands on a multiplier, it’s removed from the grid and collected into the cannon beside the grid, adding to any multiplier already stored.

 The multipliers can have one of the following values: 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x, 32x, 64x, 128x, 256x, 512x or 1024x.

 If there is a Cannon symbol on the grid it will activate and apply the multiplier stored in the cannon to the Tumble win.

 The Cannon symbol activates only if there is a winning combination and a stored multiplier in the cannon beside the grid.

 If no Cannon symbols activate, all stored multipliers are lost and reset at the start of the next spin - except when they are persistent in the bonus games.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - CANNON OF THE DAMNED
modes.trigger: landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.
modes.effects:
Trigger the Cannon of the Damned bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 Bonus scatter symbols at the same time in the base game.

 This bonus game follows all base game mechanics. In addition the multiplier stored in the cannon is persistent until triggered by a Cannon symbol.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 Set sail for the afterlife in Ghostly Hallows! This 6-reel, 5-row cascade game with all-scatter wins haunts the high seas with eerie Multiplier ghost clouds that linger behind symbols. When wins land on top of them, their power is gathered into the Cannon - and once the Cannon symbol strikes, it fires, blasting the collected multiplier across your tumble win for a spine-rattling payout!

 The max win in this game is 20 000 times your bet and can be achieved in all game modes.
